# Forum fixtures

Synthetic pages that mimic the *markup* of GGG's patch-note posts (PoE 1: `<h3>` + `<strong>` labels;
PoE 2: `<h2>` + `<h3>` boxes with a table of contents). The text is invented for the tests — no
official prose is copied. They share vocabulary on purpose: the isolation test must keep them apart.
